class.name: VideoEffectSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the quality of SSAO, SSIL, SDFGI, VoxelGI, volumetric fog, subsurface scattering and depth of field, and for player switches that turn environment effects off.

method.description: Returns [member VideoEffectSettings.brightness].

method.name: get_ignore_group
method.description: Returns the group [code]&"ignore_quality_settings"[/code]. The environment of a [WorldEnvironment] or [Camera3D] in this group is excluded from the environment overrides when the node enters the tree (see [method set_environment_ignored]).

method.name: set_environment_ignored
method.description: If [param ignored] is [code]true[/code], [param environment] is not affected by the [code]allow_*[/code] switches and the brightness, contrast and saturation of this domain (see [method RenderingServer.environment_set_ignore_global_overrides]), for example the environment of a menu background or a character preview. The flag belongs to the resource: every node that uses it is excluded.
